variables.name: MINIO_ROOT_USER
variables.description: MinIO root (admin) username. Referenced by the storage service as AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID via ${{minio.MINIO_ROOT_USER}}.

variables.name: MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD
variables.description: MinIO root password — auto-generated at deploy time. Referenced by the storage service as AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY via ${{minio.MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD}}.
